fields.claim: A template change alone may not fix delays if nobody owns the contact line.
fields.uncertainty: I do not know who staffs the line today.
assumptions: I assume the line has one shared inbox.
fields.risk: A new contact point could fill with requests nobody is assigned to answer.
fields.likelihood_basis: General contact lines often have no owner for one street.
fields.who_bears_it: Residents who write to it and wait
fields.mitigation_idea: Name the answering role on the notice and publish the answer times.

fields.claim: The problem says requests are lost but not how many were sent.
fields.uncertainty: The figure may exist somewhere I cannot see.
fields.missing_information: The number of repair requests sent and the number answered this year.
fields.why_it_matters: The ratio shows whether the delay is the rule or the exception.
fields.who_could_answer: The works office or the person who posted the problem
